description: This file defines the 'ConnectionTag' class, which encapsulates the ID and revision of a connection within the system. It provides methods to create instances manually or from JSON objects, serving as a model component in the connectivity services.

classes.name: ConnectionTag
classes.description: Immutable class representing a connection's ID and revision, with capabilities to instantiate from parameters or JSON.

methods.name: ConnectionTag.of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ConnectionTag with specified ID and revision.

methods.name: ConnectionTag.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ConnectionTag instance by parsing a JSON object, extracting the connection ID and revision, and validating the input.
